body.name: Product-experiment ordered-modulus handle
body.construction:
Solve the ordered-modulus problem for the joint treated-outcome,
replicated fixed-design regression, and full-covariance donor-location
product experiment.  Invert its least-favorable tests using each whole
unit history \((B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}},(Q_{sti})_{t=1}^{T})\) as one
stochastic coordinate, or work directly with a deterministic product-
experiment test.  The handle invokes neither a calendar-block score nor
independence of responses across dates.
